name: Tapita SEO Optimizer
summary: Shopify SEO app combining site audits with LLMs.txt for AI search engines, bulk and AI-written metadata, image alt text and compression, JSON-LD schema, broken-link auto-redirects and one-click speed fixes.
best_for: Shopify merchants on the Basic or Grow plan who want SEO audits, bulk metadata, image alt text and speed fixes out of one app instead of hiring a specialist
skip_if: you are on Shopify Advanced or Plus, where the same tier costs $30 to $60 a month more, or you need a published per-credit rate before you build a month of AI metadata around it
honest_knock:
The price on the listing is a Shopify-Basic price, and almost nobody reads the line underneath it. The same Premium plan is $49.99 on Shopify Basic, $54.99 on Grow, $79.99 on Advanced and $109.99 on Shopify Plus, because Tapita adds $5, $30 or $60 a month on top depending on your Shopify plan. On the Business tier the spread is sevenfold, $9.99 to $69.99, and it is the single largest factor in what this app costs you. Work out which row you are on before you compare it to anything else.

The ladder also moved. On our reads of 21 August and 10 September 2026 the top tier was Pro at $39.99 a month; on 9 October 2026 it is Premium at $49.99, $10 more before any surcharge.

The second meter has no published rate at all. Business gives you 100 AI metadata credits a month and Premium 500, and beyond that the listing says only that more audit pages and more credits carry an extra charge. It does not say how much, and it does not say how many credits one product's metadata consumes. Tapita's own sister app publishes $0.06 a credit on its listing; this one publishes nothing, so you cannot price a month of AI metadata before you install.

And the free tier is a demonstration rather than a plan: 50 products for bulk alt text and file names, 30 images a day, and the SEO audit and LLMs.txt limited to basic pages.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/google-seo-schema-meta-data, English listing now titled “Tapita AI SEO Optimizer, Speed”, after reads on 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12, and in our own test session on 17 November 2026) Three tiers on the Shopify Basic plan: Free, Business at $9.99 a month and Premium at $49.99 a month. Free: SEO audit and LLMs.txt on basic pages, unlimited on-page SEO audit, essential JSON-LD schemas, image compression 900 a month capped at 30 a day, bulk and AI metadata optimisation, bulk image alt text and file names for 50 products, instant page speed and 24/7 support chat for common SEO issues. Business $9.99 a month or $101.88 a year, advertised as a 15% saving (it checks out: $101.88 against $119.88), adds full features, support to fix all SEO and Google Search Console issues, SEO audit and LLMs.txt on main pages, auto image optimisation 100 a day, 100 AI metadata credits a month, broken-link detection with auto-redirects and advanced speed features. Premium $49.99 a month or $509.88 a year, also 15% ($509.88 against $599.88), adds regular page-speed and real-user-monitoring optimisation, SEO audit and LLMs.txt on all main pages, 500 images a day, 500 AI credits a month, higher speed capacity and an onboarding call. Both paid tiers carry the same surcharge line, and it is the number that decides what this costs: +$5 a month on the Shopify Grow plan, +$30 on Advanced and +$60 on Shopify Plus. So Business is $9.99, $14.99, $39.99 or $69.99, and Premium is $49.99, $54.99, $79.99 or $109.99, depending on which Shopify plan you are on (our arithmetic on the listed rates). Extra audit pages and extra AI credits are billed on top and the listing does not print a per-credit rate. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. A Black Friday and Cyber Monday offer ran inside the app in our own test session on 17 November 2026, not on the listing: code BFCM2026 took 50% off the first three months, so Business at $4.99 and Premium at $24.99 for each of those three months, then the regular $9.99 and $49.99. The banner said the offer ends 4 December 2026. On Business the purchase dialog showed the $9.99 monthly charge, a $5.00 discount labelled BFCM 2026 for the first 3 months and a total of $4.99, behind a required Terms and Conditions checkbox; we did not buy. Historical: on our reads of 21 August and 10 September 2026 the paid tiers were called Basic ($9.99, $101.88 a year) and Pro ($39.99, $408 a year), and Pro then listed unlimited keyword research, which no tier lists on 9 October 2026. Developer Tapita, M5 Building, 91 Nguyen Chi Thanh, Hanoi; the app launched 15 March 2023 and carries Shopify's “Built for Shopify” badge. On 17 November 2026 the listing showed 5.0 from 2,630 reviews.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Tapita SEO Optimizer on a Shopify development store on the Free plan only in part: the install, the product scores in Content Optimization (about 2 minutes and 4 clicks after the install), the Critical list of one product (score 34), and Optimize alt on one image, which gave Alt updated! with an AI alt text (5 AI credits were available) and was written to the store. The site audit gave no result because the store is password-protected and the app embed was off. The Business purchase window (Grand Total $4.99 in a sale until 4 December) asked for a terms box that was not ticked, so the Shopify approval screen was not reached. The app was uninstalled afterwards. Nothing was paid; the alt text of one image in the store stayed changed. Install: the app was installed through the App Store form in our own tab at 17:23:59; the listing now calls the app Tapita AI SEO Optimizer, Speed (the dossier says Tapita SEO Optimizer), the admin calls it Tapita SEO & Speed, and the listing shows the Built for Shopify badge and 5.0 from 2,630 reviews (the dossier has 2,470). The dialog Install app asked for View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data (Products, Online Store). After Install the app redirected through the vendor domain and stayed on a Please wait page; we opened the app by its admin address. The app was open on the Free plan with no payment step at about 17:25. The listing price block (Free; Business $9.99 a month or $101.88 a year, save 15%; Premium $49.99 a month or $509.88 a year; plus $5 a month on Shopify Grow, $30 on Advanced and $60 on Shopify Plus; more audit pages and AI credits cost extra) is the same as in the dossier. Core action, an SEO scan and an AI alt text: the site audit was NOT completed. Site Audit, Scan, Start Scanning (language English, the store address) showed no result after about 25 seconds and stayed on the page with the message Please enable Tapita app embed first. The store has a password (the app says Your store is currently password-protected) and the app embed was off, so the audit could not read the store; we did not turn the password off and did not turn the embed on. What did work: Content Optimization already showed a list of products with a Score (for example 30, 34 and 38) about 2 minutes and 4 clicks after the install (about 17:26). For the product The Videographer Snowboard (score 34) the app showed Critical (2): Missing product description and Missing meta description, Need improvement (2) and Good (4), a title of 26 of 150 characters and the alt text Video of the Snowboard. for the second image. Optimize alt opened the AI Alt Text Optimizer with Available AI credits 5, a limit of 100 images a day and 5 credits per day, 0 of 22 images optimized and 22 unoptimized. On the file snowboard_sky.jpg (Needs alt text) we clicked Optimize and the window Recently updated said Alt updated! with the alt text Snowboard shown front and back: turquoise base with white pixel-art waves and a purple-pink abstract pattern (about 17:27, about 3.5 minutes after the install, 1 image). The text was written to Shopify directly: the alt text of that one image in the store IS changed and was not put back. We clicked OK and not Update. How many of the 5 credits this used was not read off the screen afterwards. No AI optimize for a title or meta description was run, no bulk run and no auto-optimize was switched on. Plans: the Pricing page shows Free (current) with site audit and LLMs.txt on basic pages, unlimited onpage SEO audit, manual image optimization 30 images a day, product image alt and file name bulk optimization for 50 products and 5 AI credits (non-recurring); Business at $4.99 a month (struck-through $9.99, 50% off for the first 3 months, then $9.99 a month) with 100 AI credits a month and a site audit on 150 main pages; Premium at $24.99 a month (struck-through $49.99, then $49.99 a month) with 500 AI credits a month, a site audit on all main pages (more pages cost extra) and an onboarding call. A banner says BFCM SALE Black Friday and Cyber Monday, 50% off your first 3 months, code BFCM2026, offer ends Dec 4, 2026. On this Basic test store the base price of Business is $9.99, as in the dossier, and no Shopify plan surcharge was shown in the dialog. The price of an extra AI credit was not shown and the sliders were not moved. Differences with the dossier: no difference in the prices; the sale (Business $4.99 and Premium $24.99 for the first 3 months, until 4 December 2026) is not in the dossier; the listing name and the review count (2,630 against 2,470) differ from the dossier. Checkout: NOT reached. Switch plan on Business opened the window Purchase plan of the app itself with Coupon Applied, Business Plan $9.99, SEO Audit Pages 150 pages +$0.00, Monthly AI credits 100 credits +$0.00, Monthly charge $9.99, Discount (BFCM 2026, first 3 months) -$5.00 and Grand Total $4.99, and a checkbox I understand and agree with the Terms and Conditions, with Continue greyed out until it is ticked. We did not tick it and clicked Cancel, so the Shopify screen Approve subscription was never opened and no test charge text was seen. Cancelling: no paid plan was started, so nothing could be cancelled. The way to stop was to uninstall the app through Settings, Apps, the three dots menu, Uninstall (reason Testing multiple apps, no feedback given); Shopify said the app was successfully uninstalled. Not tested: a finished site audit, AI metadata or title optimization, any paid plan, the Shopify approval screen, the Advanced and Plus surcharges, the price of extra credits, the Search Console link and the theme app embed. The separate app Tapita AI SEO Blog Builder was not tested. Clean up: the app was uninstalled; no theme change was saved because the app embed was never switched on; the alt text of one image (snowboard_sky.jpg) in the store was changed by the test and left that way. Our own tab was closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The site audit gave no result (password-protected store, app embed off, only the message Please enable Tapita app embed first), the install redirect stayed on a Please wait page, the Business purchase window needs a terms box before Continue works, the sale price of $4.99 runs for the first 3 months only, and the alt text of one image in the store was changed and was not put back.

claim_checks.plan: Free plan; Business purchase window seen and cancelled
